main.summary: Owns the item and session locks required for a transfer mutation workflow.
main.remarks: The item lock is acquired before the session lock and both locks are released when the scope is disposed.

property.name: ItemID
property.summary: Gets the item identifier protected by this mutation scope.
property.value: Item identifier owned by the scope.

property.name: SessionID
property.summary: Gets the session identifier protected by this mutation scope.
property.value: Session identifier owned by the scope.
